text:
Maya: Quick sync — follow-ups from last week's authz outage. Need clear owners for the remaining action items: token validation tests, audit logging dashboards, permissions sweep, and secrets rotation. Can we assign owners and dates?
Sam: I can own token validation tests. Will create a ticket and add CI jobs.
Priya: I can do the audit logging dashboards and queries, then wire alerts into the console.
Lucas: I'll take the permissions sweep/ACL drift analysis and coordinate with SRE for any infra fixes.
Maya: Thanks. Tentative dates: token tests by EOD Fri (this week), dashboards by next Wed, secrets rotation plan by next Mon. Agree? :calendar:
Elliot: Noted recurring pattern: ACL drift seems to correlate with autoscaler node replacements. We should add a weekly audit job that validates critical roles after scale events.
Priya: Adding the initial query I'll use for investigation: ```sql
SELECT user_id, action, resource, success, ts
FROM audit_logs
WHERE action LIKE '%token%' OR action LIKE '%authz%'
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
Priya: I'll add a saved query in Looker and a dashboard panel for error rate + top failing resources.
Sam: Created https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-431 to track token validation tests. PR for CI job coming by Thu.
Lucas: I'll open SEC-432 for permissions sweep and include automated expectation checks against the manifest. Also will add a runbook snippet to handle drift.
Maya: For secrets rotation: @sec-bot when was last rotation for service keys?
sec-bot: Last rotation for redwood-service-keys: 2025-11-03. Policy: 90-day rotation recommended. :robot_face:
Lucas: I'll coordinate rotation with infra; plan is rolling key replacement (no downtime) and a canary verification job. Draft schedule Monday-Wednesday next week.
Sam: For token tests: will add unit and integration tests + a nightly smoketest against staging auth flow. Will request reviews from @Priya and @Lucas.
Priya: I'll add an alert: audit_error_rate > 0.5% over 15m -> pager to sec-oncall and ops. Also schedule a weekly regression harness that runs the saved prompt set for token validation.
Maya: Action items recap (I'll add to postmortem doc): Sam -> token validation tests (SEC-431) due EOD Fri; Priya -> audit dashboards & alerts (SEC-433) due next Wed; Lucas -> permissions sweep + rotation coordination (SEC-432) draft schedule next Mon; Elliot -> weekly ACL drift check proposal and runbook snippet.
Maya: Also note pattern: most failures are during high rollout churn windows. We should add a pre-rollout verification checklist to reduce recurrence.
Sam: I'll include pre-rollout token sanity checks in the CI pipeline and a gating step.
Priya: Linking postmortem doc: https://docs.redwood.com/postmortems/authz-incident-2026 (will update owner table).
Maya: OK team — I'll run a status-check thread next Tue 09:00 to verify progress. Please update your tickets and add short notes in the postmortem doc. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
Elliot: Thanks — flagged recurring pattern in the incident tracker and assigned a weekly reminder.
sec-bot: Reminder set: weekly ACL-drift-check cron -> Mondays 04:00 UTC.
__notes: Generated Slack thread for incident follow-up; names are Redwood-style employees and a bot. Single-string conversation as required by agents.md.
